item.title: Sustaining Local News: The Village Reporter Adjusts Price To Preserve Coverage
item.description: BY: NEWSPAPER STAFF The Village Reporter will increase its single-copy price from $2.00 to $3.00, effective the February 4, 2026 edition (this week). This marks the first price change since prior to the COVID-19 pandemic and comes in response to the rising costs associated with producing a high-quality community newspaper.
